# Biography.com

> > Comprehensive biographical resource covering influential figures across literature, science, and history, from Miguel de Cervantes and Herman Melville to Ernest Rutherford and beyond.

Biography.com provides detailed life stories, achievements, and historical context for notable individuals who shaped world culture, literature, science, and the arts. The site features extensive coverage of authors, scientists, playwrights, and other influential figures from the 16th century to modern times.

## Key Topics

- Don Quixote
- Miguel de Cervantes
- Spanish Literature
- Golden Age Authors
- 19th Century Literature
- Nuclear Physics
- Nobel Prize Winners
- Battle of Lepanto
- English Literature
- Scandinavian Drama
- Children's Literature
- Scientific Discoveries
- Literary Classics
- Historical Figures
- Cultural Icons

## Authors & Writers

- [Miguel de Cervantes - Don Quixote, Books & Facts](https://www.biography.com/authors-writers/miguel-de-cervantes): Spanish author Miguel de Cervantes, creator of Don Quixote masterpiece
- [Herman Melville - Books, Quotes & Moby Dick](https://www.biography.com/authors-writers/herman-melville): American author Herman Melville, writer of Moby-Dick and sea adventures
- [Alexandre Dumas - Books, Ethnicity & Quotes](https://www.biography.com/authors-writers/alexandre-dumas): French novelist Alexandre Dumas, author of The Three Musketeers
- [Beatrix Potter - Books, Movie & Peter Rabbit](https://www.biography.com/writer/beatrix-potter): British author Beatrix Potter, creator of Peter Rabbit children's books
- [Henrik Ibsen - Life, A Doll's House & Hedda Gabler](https://www.biography.com/writer/henrik-ibsen): Norwegian playwright Henrik Ibsen, author of A Doll's House drama

## Scientists & Nobel Laureates

- [Ernest Rutherford - Model, Discoveries & Experiment](https://www.biography.com/scientist/ernest-rutherford): Nobel Prize physicist Ernest Rutherford's nuclear physics discoveries
